note: Controlled vocabulary for the requested_actions field. Must stay identical to the schema enum; scripts/check_taxonomy_consistency.py enforces this.

requested_actions.label: Send money
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to transfer funds or make a payment.

requested_actions.label: Share one-time code
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to reveal a one-time password or verification code.

requested_actions.label: Disclose credentials
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to reveal a username, password, PIN, or similar secret.

requested_actions.label: Click a link
requested_actions.definition: The target is directed to open a link. Records never contain a real or live URL.

requested_actions.label: Install an app
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to install software or an application.

requested_actions.label: Call a number
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to call a phone number. Records never contain a real number.

requested_actions.label: Share an identity document
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to provide an identity document or its details.

requested_actions.label: Provide personal data
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked for personal data such as date of birth or address.

requested_actions.label: Approve a transaction
requested_actions.definition: The target is asked to approve or authorise a transaction or request.

requested_actions.label: Other
requested_actions.definition: A requested action not represented above; requires a documented rationale.
